description: This file defines the Signer class within the Aws\CloudFront namespace. It provides methods to create signed URLs and cookies for Amazon CloudFront by generating cryptographic signatures with a private key. The class handles private key loading, signature creation, and encodes the resulting signatures for use in secure content delivery.

classes.name: Signer
classes.description: A utility class for generating signed URLs and cookies for CloudFront secured content, using a private key and key pair ID to produce cryptographic signatures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Signer with the key pair ID, private key path or content, and optional passphrase. Loads the private key resource for signing operations.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the private key handle if PHP version is below 8 to free resources.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Generates signature parameters for signing URLs or cookies based on the provided resource, expiration, or custom policy.

methods.name: createCannedPolicy
methods.description: Creates a JSON policy for a specific resource with an expiration time, used in generating signed URLs.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs the provided policy string with the private key, returning the signature or throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Base64 encodes the input and performs URL-safe replacements to produce a signature string suitable for URL inclusion.
